title: In the command line
caption: The project plan for people who work in a terminal: prompts become commands.

readme.heading: Read me
readme.shows: The project-plan Workflow with the CLI toggle on, so every stage copies CLI setup and /skill commands instead of chat prompts.
readme.tryit: Open a stage and copy its first command. Switch the CLI toggle off to go back to Chat and see the same step as a plain prompt.
readme.notice: Only what a step copies changes. The stages, the checks and your place in the loop stay the same.
